# Repository layout

What each top-level directory of this repository holds, which files in it are generated and by which generator,
and which of them reach the built package.
How the generators are run, and in which order, is [`dplyr-alignment/sync/`](/handbook/dplyr-alignment/sync/README.md)'s.

**A generated file is changed at its generator, not in place.**
Most generated R and test files say so in their first line, as `# Generated by <generator>`,
and `grep -l '^# Generated by' R/*.R tests/testthat/*.R` lists them.
An edit to one is lost at the next run, with one exception:
the generated verb methods and vendored dplyr tests keep their manual edits as patch files
([`dplyr-alignment/patches/`](/handbook/dplyr-alignment/patches/README.md)).
`R/not-supported.R`, the files under `dplyr-methods/`, and the patch files themselves are generated too, and carry no such header.
Every script named below lives in [`tools/`](/tools/README.md), whose README is the reference for what each one reads and writes.

**`R/`** holds the package source, generated and hand-written side by side:

* `R/<verb>.R`, one per dplyr `data.frame` method duckplyr wraps ([`verbs/`](/handbook/verbs/README.md)),
  is generated by `tools/02-duckplyr_df-methods.R` and then patched;
  its documentation is hand-written beside it in `R/<verb>-rd.R`, where the verb is documented at all.
* `R/overwrite.R` and `R/restore.R` are generated by `tools/07-overwrite.R`.
* `R/not-supported.R` is generated by `tools/80-unsupported.R`.
* `R/tpch_raw_*.R` and `R/tpch_raw_oo_*.R` are generated by the TPC-H peel scripts ([`benchmarks/`](/handbook/benchmarks/README.md)).
* `R/globals.R` is generated by roxyglobals when the package is documented.
* Everything else is hand-written, the relational layer (`R/relational*.R`) and the translations (`R/translate.R`) among it.

A few files under `R/` serve development only and are excluded from the built package by [`.Rbuildignore`](/.Rbuildignore),
which is the list; `R/meta.R`, the operation recorder the generated `rel_api` tests and the TPC-H peel scripts rely on, is one.

**`dplyr-methods/`** holds the source of each dplyr `data.frame` method as it was at the last sync,
one text file per method, written by `tools/01-dplyr-methods.R` and read by `tools/02-duckplyr_df-methods.R`.

**`patch/` and `patch-tests/`** hold the manual edits to generated methods and vendored tests as diffs,
written and applied by the generators ([`dplyr-alignment/patches/`](/handbook/dplyr-alignment/patches/README.md)).

**`tests/testthat/`** mixes native and generated tests, and [`testing/`](/handbook/testing/README.md) says which is which.

**`tools/`** holds the developer scripts, run by hand and never by the package.

**`.sync/`** holds the helper clones of dplyr, which git does not track,
and a README saying what they are ([`dplyr-alignment/setup/`](/handbook/dplyr-alignment/setup/README.md)).

**`man/` and `NAMESPACE`** are generated by roxygen2 from `R/`.

**`vignettes/`** holds the articles of the pkgdown site, hand-written;
`vignettes/limits.Rmd` is the user-facing list of translated functions ([`translations/`](/handbook/translations/README.md)).

**`README.Rmd`** renders to `README.md` and `index.md`, replaying recorded output from `README-fixtures/`;
how to re-record it is the comment inside `README.Rmd`.

**`NEWS.md`** is maintained by [fledge](https://fledge.cynkra.com) from commit messages, and is not edited by hand.

**`touchstone/` and the `res-*.csv` files** are benchmark scripts and results ([`benchmarks/`](/handbook/benchmarks/README.md)).

**`gh-analysis/`** is a one-off analysis of how dplyr is used on GitHub, and [its README](/gh-analysis/README.md) documents it.

**`pkgdown/` and `_pkgdown.yml`** configure the website, and `.aspell/` holds the spelling dictionary `tools/85-spelling.R` updates.

**`.github/`** holds the workflows ([`ci/`](/handbook/ci/README.md)) and the contributing guide.

**The documentation system** is `handbook/`, `experiments/`, `.claude/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.handbook-source`,
and `.handbook-ignore` ([`meta/local/`](/handbook/meta/local/README.md)).

*To deepen: verify each directory's role against its maintainer, and flip this page to confirmed.*
